Geographies Served Programs Anviksha Early Education Program District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra In alignment with our belief in the importance of quality early education and FLN goals of the NIPUN Bharat initiative, SAC collaborated with the BMC to adopt 55 pre-primary classrooms across 14 English Medium schools in Mumbai in 2025 - 2026; benefiting 2000+ children. The program involved classroom teacher support, curriculum development and delivery, teacher recruitment & training and implementing pedagogy in line with NIPUN Bharat outcomes Co-curricular activities around sports, art and movement, games, critical thinking etc were also integrated with the academic program The success of the program strengthens our mission to scale this program for the upcoming years as well. To support 100 children annually 7.5 Lakh INR 1 child for a year 7.5k INR Foundational Learning Program District Mumbai State Maharashtra District Mumbai States Maharashtra It is a fully volunteer led - after school Program. Includes pure academic support by volunteers preparing the children through their Primary & Middle School on an everyday Basis. This program aims at building & strengthening the basic concepts of Math. Also reading , speaking & comprehension of English. We expose them to other skills of Dance, Yoga, Art & Life Skills as well. The program provides an excellent opportunity for volunteers to engage with the children through carefully crafted modules. Its a Robust curriculum delivered by educated & trained volunteers in a positive , encouraging atmosphere. Stationary , Study Material , workbooks etc are provided free of cost to our participating students. We are currently at 300 students in 25-26 and will touch 800 students in 26-27.
